title: FairQE: Multi-Agent Framework for Mitigating Gender Bias in Translation Quality Estimation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing Translation Quality Estimation (QE) score ratios between feminine and masculine translations, as well as neutral and gendered translations, for gender-ambiguous source sentences. Additionally, measuring the binary accuracy of QE models in assigning higher scores to gender-aligned translations compared to gender-misaligned ones for gender-explicit source sentences using counterfactual datasets.
